#!/bin/bash

# -----------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# -----------------------------

VM_NAME="Windows11-AutoVM"
RAM_MB=12288
CPUS=6
DISK_MB=102400

ISO_URL="https://software-static.download.prss.microsoft.com/dbazure/888969d5-f34g-4e03-ac9d-1f9786c66749/26200.6584.250915-1905.25h2_ge_release_svc_refresh_CLIENT_CONSUMER_x64FRE_en-us.iso"

ISO_NAME="windows11.iso"

# -----------------------------

echo "Starting full Windows VM installation..."

# Run as root automatically
if [ "$EUID" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Running with administrator privileges..."
    exec sudo bash "$0" "$@"
fi

USER_HOME=$(eval echo "~$SUDO_USER")

DOWNLOAD_DIR="$USER_HOME/Downloads"
ISO_PATH="$DOWNLOAD_DIR/$ISO_NAME"
VM_DIR="$USER_HOME/VirtualBox VMs"

echo "Preparing directories..."

mkdir -p "$DOWNLOAD_DIR"
mkdir -p "$VM_DIR"

echo "Updating system..."
apt update -y

echo "Installing required packages..."
apt install -y wget curl dkms build-essential linux-headers-$(uname -r)

echo "Installing VirtualBox..."
apt install -y virtualbox virtualbox-ext-pack

echo "Downloading Windows ISO..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER wget -O "$ISO_PATH" "$ISO_URL"

if [ ! -f "$ISO_PATH" ]; then
    echo "ISO download failed!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Download completed."

echo "Checking ISO file..."

FILE_TYPE=$(file "$ISO_PATH")

if [[ $FILE_TYPE != *"ISO 9660"* ]]; then
    echo "Downloaded file is not a valid ISO!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "ISO verified."

echo "Creating Virtual Machine..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER VBoxManage createvm \
--name "$VM_NAME" \
--ostype Windows11_64 \
--register

echo "Configuring hardware..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER VBoxManage modifyvm "$VM_NAME" \
--memory $RAM_MB \
--cpus $CPUS \
--vram 256 \
--graphicscontroller vmsvga \
--accelerate3d on \
--clipboard-mode bidirectional \
--draganddrop bidirectional \
--nic1 nat \
--boot1 dvd

echo "Creating virtual disk..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER VBoxManage createmedium disk \
--filename "$VM_DIR/$VM_NAME/$VM_NAME.vdi" \
--size $DISK_MB \
--format VDI

echo "Creating storage controller..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER VBoxManage storagectl "$VM_NAME" \
--name "SATA Controller" \
--add sata \
--controller IntelAhci

echo "Attaching disk..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER VBoxManage storageattach "$VM_NAME" \
--storagectl "SATA Controller" \
--port 0 \
--device 0 \
--type hdd \
--medium "$VM_DIR/$VM_NAME/$VM_NAME.vdi"

echo "Attaching Windows ISO..."

sudo -u $SUDO_USER VBoxManage storageattach "$VM_NAME" \
--storagectl "SATA Controller" \
--port 1 \
--device 0 \
--type dvddrive \
--medium "$ISO_PATH"

echo ""
echo "======================================"
echo "Setup Complete"
echo "======================================"
echo ""
echo "Open VirtualBox from Applications"
echo ""
echo "Start VM: $VM_NAME"
echo ""
echo "Windows installer will launch."
echo ""
echo "======================================"
